title: Signed: Laufey Inks Label Deal With Interscope/Verve; CHVRCHES Looks to the Futures
summary: Other recent artist signings include Vic Mensa, Alfredo Gutiérrez, Ava Liv Mabry and JYT.
contentText:
Two-time Grammy winner Laufey signed to Interscope/Verve Records . The jazz/classical singer-songwriter recently wrapped her 70-date A Matter of Time global arena tour in Mexico City.

Laufey, who was named Billboard ‘s Women in Music Innovator earlier this year, previously had a global recording deal with AWAL, which she signed in 2020 after her music began taking off during the pandemic. She released her debut album, Everything I Know About Love , in 2022, followed by 2023’s Bewitched , which topped Billboard ‘s Jazz Albums and Traditional Jazz Albums charts, and 2025’s A Matter of Time , which reached No. 4 on the Billboard 200. — Chris Eggertsen

CHVRCHES (Photo Credit: Jody Evans)

Jody Evans

Scottish synth-pop trio CHVRCHES signed a label deal with Futures Music Group , which released the band’s new single “Roses” — its first new single in three years.

CHVRCHES’ last album, Screen Violence , was released in 2021. The band scored a Billboard Hot 100 entry in 2019 with “Here With Me,” a Marshmello track on which the band was featured, and it has racked up a total of four albums on the Billboard 200, including 2015’s Every Open Eye , which hit No. 8 on the chart. — Chris Eggertsen

Vic Mensa (Photo Credit: Onda)

Onda

Grammy-nominated artist Vic Mensa signed a distribution partnership with UnitedMasters through which he will release his debut project, INNANETAPE , on streaming services for the first time on Sept. 29, along with a new album next year.

Mensa has charted twice on the Billboard 200, with his 2016 EP, There’s Alot Going On , and his 2017 album, The Autobiography . — Chris Eggertsen
